beats.label: S1 · The compass
beats.text: The Pogues find a motel key on a sunken ship; it leads them to a compass that belonged to John B's missing father.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The compass is the entry point to every mystery the show ever runs.

beats.label: S1 · The tape
beats.text: A clue inside the compass leads to a grave where the Pogues find a Royal Merchant map and a tape of Big John telling John B to finish what he started.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the Royal Merchant hunt and John B's personal mission from his father.

beats.label: S1 · Ward moves in
beats.text: Ward Cameron, John B's employer and Sarah's father, takes John B in as his legal guardian after Topper attacks him — steering the treasure hunt from within.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Positions Ward inside the group before the reveal of what he actually did.

beats.label: S1 · The gold in the well
beats.text: The Pogues raid the Crain house and find the Royal Merchant gold in an old well; Ward overhears their plans and steals the haul out from under them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The gold moves to Ward, setting up every retrieval attempt that follows.

beats.label: S1 · Ward exposed
beats.text: On a fishing trip Ward reveals enough for John B to realize Ward killed Big John for the treasure map; John B turns the boat back to hand him in.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Ward from father figure into the villain John B must take down.

beats.label: S1 · Rafe shoots Peterkin
beats.text: At the airstrip Sheriff Peterkin moves to arrest Ward — Rafe shoots her dead to save his father, and Ward frames John B for the murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The killing and the frame-up power the fugitive chase across the next two seasons.

beats.label: S1 · Presumed dead
beats.text: John B and Sarah flee in a stolen boat, capsize in a storm, and are presumed dead — but wash up on a cargo ship bound for Nassau, where Ward's gold now sits.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the Bahamas gold-heist premise the next season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: John B and Sarah are alive on a Bahamas-bound cargo ship — but the Pogues and the police think they drowned. Ward is under arrest, and his stolen gold sits in Nassau, waiting.
questions: Can John B ever clear his name and prove Ward killed his father?
Will the Pogues learn John B and Sarah are alive?
Can they steal the gold back before Ward disappears with it?

characters.name: John B Routledge
characters.line: Pogue whose father vanished chasing the Royal Merchant gold; framed for Peterkin's murder and presumed drowned, actually alive on a cargo ship.

characters.name: Sarah Cameron
characters.line: Ward's daughter who left the Kooks for John B; presumed dead beside him but alive and bound for the Bahamas.

characters.name: Ward Cameron
characters.line: Wealthy landowner and John B's former boss; killed Big John for the treasure map and is covering up Rafe's murder of Peterkin.

characters.name: Rafe Cameron
characters.line: Ward's volatile son; shot Sheriff Peterkin at the airstrip and got away with it under his father's frame-up.

characters.name: JJ Maybank
characters.line: Pogue with a brutal father Luke; hot-headed loyalist who believes John B is dead.

characters.name: Pope Heyward
characters.line: Studious Pogue who blew his scholarship interview to help John B; now dating Kiara.

characters.name: Kiara Carrera
characters.line: Pogue from a wealthy Kildare family who moves between the two worlds; now with Pope.

beats.label: S2 · Bahamas and Cleo
beats.text: John B and Sarah surface in the Bahamas; captain Terrance helps them target Ward's gold but betrays them, and his crewmate Cleo defects to their side.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Cleo, who becomes a permanent Pogue.

beats.label: S2 · Sarah shot, home to Kildare
beats.text: Rafe shoots Sarah — aiming for John B — and the couple limp home to Kildare, where the Pogues are hatching a plan to clear John B of Peterkin's murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the gold thread and pivots the season back to Kildare and the frame-up.

beats.label: S2 · Limbrey's bargain
beats.text: Carla Limbrey approaches the Pogues with a taped confession that could free John B, but demands a key which leads to the Cross of Santo Domingo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Limbrey and pivots the treasure hunt from gold to the Cross.

beats.label: S2 · Ward stages his death
beats.text: The Pogues trade a fake key for the tape and hand it to police; cornered on his boat, Ward blows himself up in a staged death, and Rafe walks free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ward's fake suicide is the season's central deception; Rafe inherits the empire.

beats.label: S2 · Pope's ancestor
beats.text: The Cross's trail leads to Pope's own ancestor Denmark Tanny and a hidden church, where Pope finds the Cross — only for Rafe and Limbrey's men to steal it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Makes the Cross Pope's personal fight and moves it out of the Pogues' hands.

beats.label: S2 · Coastal Venture
beats.text: The Pogues stow away on the Coastal Venture as Rafe hauls the gold and Cross out to sea; the fight ends with Pope forced overboard and Sarah nearly drowned.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Loses the Cross overboard and forces the Pogues off the ship into the ocean.

beats.label: S2 · Poguelandia · Big John lives
beats.text: The Pogues escape on a lifeboat and wash up on a deserted island they name Poguelandia; ashore, Limbrey walks in on Big John Routledge — alive all along.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two setups the next season opens on: the island and Big John's survival.

cliffhanger.text: The Pogues are stranded on a deserted island with no way home, the Camerons keep the gold, and unknown to John B, his father Big John is alive — striking a deal with Limbrey.
questions: How will the Pogues get off Poguelandia?
What will John B do when he finds out his father is alive?
Can they take down the Camerons and reclaim what was stolen?

characters.name: John B Routledge
characters.line: Pogue cleared of Peterkin's murder by the taped confession, now stranded on Poguelandia and unaware his father is alive.

characters.name: Sarah Cameron
characters.line: Fully broken from her family after surviving Rafe's bullet; stranded with the Pogues.

characters.name: Big John Routledge
characters.line: Presumed dead for two seasons; revealed alive at the finale and cutting a deal with Limbrey to help John B.

characters.name: Ward Cameron
characters.line: Faked his suicide by blowing up his boat; secretly alive with the gold and free of the frame-up.

characters.name: Rafe Cameron
characters.line: Cleared of Peterkin's murder by his father's staged confession; now handling the Cameron empire and the stolen Cross.

characters.name: Carla Limbrey
characters.line: Dying Charleston heiress whose family has hunted the Cross for centuries; now holding Big John.

characters.name: Cleo
characters.line: Bahamian former crewmate of Terrance who chose the Pogues; now one of them, stranded on Poguelandia.

characters.name: JJ Maybank
characters.line: Pogue stranded on Poguelandia after taking down the crew of the Coastal Venture.

characters.name: Pope Heyward
characters.line: Learned his ancestor Denmark Tanny is at the heart of the Cross's story; stranded with the Pogues.

characters.name: Kiara Carrera
characters.line: Kicked out by her mother, now roughing it with the Pogues; stranded on Poguelandia.

beats.label: S3 · Singh's kidnap
beats.text: A pilot rescues the Pogues from Poguelandia — then delivers them to Carlos Singh, a Caribbean treasure hunter who kidnaps Kiara for Denmark Tanny's diary.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Singh, the season's antagonist, and repositions the treasure at El Dorado.

beats.label: S3 · Reunion with Big John
beats.text: John B follows church bells to a reunion with his father Big John; Big John reveals the true prize behind the Royal Merchant gold is the lost city of El Dorado.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The El Dorado premise and the father-son reunion drive the whole season.

beats.label: S3 · The Cross melted
beats.text: Big John's obsession with El Dorado turns John B distant and secretive; back on Kildare Rafe defies Ward, melts the Cross of Santo Domingo down and sells the pieces.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the Cross storyline and marks Rafe cutting ties with his father.

beats.label: S3 · Sarah, Topper, and the fire
beats.text: Hurt by John B's distance, Sarah sleeps with Topper and confesses; John B beats Topper in public, and Topper burns the Pogues' house down in revenge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Breaks and remakes the John B–Sarah bond that anchors the finale.

beats.label: S3 · South America
beats.text: Ward — secretly alive — helps the group escape to South America on his jet; Rafe hires Barry to kill Ward but rushes in to save him at the last moment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Moves the endgame to South America and softens Rafe toward his father.

beats.label: S3 · El Dorado, two fathers dead
beats.text: In the caves beneath Solana, John B and Sarah find El Dorado; Singh mortally wounds Big John, and Ward dies shielding Sarah from Singh's men.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills both fathers, resolves the Cameron/Routledge war, and delivers the treasure.

beats.label: S3 · Eighteen months on
beats.text: Eighteen months later, the Pogues are honored as heroes for finding El Dorado and take a new commission: locate the wreck of Blackbeard's lost ship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The eighteen-month jump and the Blackbeard hook are the exact premise Season 4 opens on.

cliffhanger.text: The Pogues are celebrated El Dorado heroes eighteen months on, having lost both Big John and Ward. Now they take on a new hunt — Blackbeard's lost ship — with strangers pointing the way.
questions: What draws the Pogues back into treasure hunting so soon after El Dorado?
Can the people commissioning the Blackbeard hunt be trusted?
Where does Rafe — the last Cameron standing — fit in now that Ward is gone?

characters.name: John B Routledge
characters.line: Newly orphaned and celebrated as an El Dorado hero; carrying the loss of his father.

characters.name: Sarah Cameron
characters.line: Reconciled with John B after briefly returning to Topper; orphaned by Ward's death in the caves.

characters.name: JJ Maybank
characters.line: Pogue, El Dorado hero, quietly closer to Kiara than he was.

characters.name: Kiara Carrera
characters.line: Pogue, El Dorado hero, in a slow-burn thing with JJ.

characters.name: Pope Heyward
characters.line: Pogue, El Dorado hero, now in a relationship with Cleo.

characters.name: Cleo
characters.line: Full Pogue and Pope's partner.

characters.name: Rafe Cameron
characters.line: The only surviving Cameron heir after Ward's death; unstable, unpredictable, back on Kildare.

characters.name: Topper Thornton
characters.line: The Kook Sarah briefly returned to; burned the Pogues' house down after John B beat him in public.

beats.label: S4 · Broke, and Groff
beats.text: The Pogues sink their gold into JJ's land as a business but come up short on taxes; Chandler Groff hires them to find a cursed amulet on Blackbeard's ship.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the money pressure that drives the whole season and introduces Groff.

beats.label: S4 · Amulet and the Corsairs
beats.text: JJ and Kiara recover the amulet from Blackbeard's wreck, drawing the Lupine Corsairs — a treasure crew led by the enforcer Lightner — onto the Pogues.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the amulet in play and introduces the season's foot-soldier antagonists.

beats.label: S4 · Groff is JJ's father
beats.text: Luke reveals that JJ's true father is Chandler Groff himself; Groff, working with Rafe's new partner Hollis Robinson, wants the Blue Crown the amulet's map leads to.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The paternity reveal is the season's emotional engine and pulls Groff to the centre.

beats.label: S4 · Pregnancy, Hollis dead, JJ framed
beats.text: Sarah tells John B she's pregnant; Groff murders Hollis over the money and plants evidence framing JJ, forcing the Pogues to flee for Morocco to catch Groff.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the pregnancy, moves the story to Morocco, and puts JJ on the run.

beats.label: S4 · Rafe joins, JJ saves Sarah
beats.text: Rafe, hunting Groff for his own reasons, joins the Pogues aboard Terrance's boat; a storm nearly drowns Sarah and JJ dives in to save her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Rafe on the Pogue side and reinforces JJ's loyalty just before the finale.

beats.label: S4 · Blue Crown found
beats.text: In the Moroccan town of Agapenta, Pope shoots Lightner dead and JJ finds the Blue Crown — only for Groff to escape a well and take Kiara hostage.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The hostage swap is what walks JJ into Groff's ambush.

beats.label: S4 · JJ dies
beats.text: JJ trades the Blue Crown for Kiara, but Groff murders JJ in revenge for leaving him to die; JJ confesses his love to Kiara as he dies, and Groff flees for Lisbon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: JJ's death and Groff's escape are the exact facts the next season opens on.

cliffhanger.text: JJ is dead — murdered by his own biological father Chandler Groff moments after declaring his love for Kiara. Groff has vanished toward Lisbon with the Blue Crown. Sarah is carrying John B's child.
questions: Will the Pogues track Groff to Lisbon and avenge JJ?
How does Kiara survive losing the boy she just admitted she loved?
How will John B and Sarah navigate impending parenthood in the middle of another hunt?

characters.name: JJ Maybank
characters.line: Killed in Agapenta by his biological father Chandler Groff; his death is what drives the group forward.

characters.name: Kiara Carrera
characters.line: JJ confessed his love to her moments before Groff murdered him; devastated.

characters.name: Chandler Groff
characters.line: JJ's biological father, revealed mid-season; killed his own son and escaped for Lisbon with the Blue Crown.

characters.name: John B Routledge
characters.line: Father-to-be, grieving JJ.

characters.name: Sarah Cameron
characters.line: Pregnant with John B's child; reconciled with Rafe as her last remaining family.

characters.name: Rafe Cameron
characters.line: Back in the Pogue fold after helping in Morocco; reconciled with Sarah.

characters.name: Pope Heyward
characters.line: Killed Lightner in Agapenta; dodged Marine service; still with Cleo.

characters.name: Cleo
characters.line: Full Pogue and Pope's partner through the Morocco chase.
